# NIAN Custom Homes

> Family-owned custom home builder in Naples, Florida, in the Southwest Florida real estate market since 2006 ("a family owned and operated company"; "primarily a Custom Home builder"). They help clients secure the lot, design the plan and choose every finish, then build the home: "No two clients are the same and neither should their home." Licensed in Florida: Certified Building Contractor CBC1260134 (NIAN CUSTOM HOMES INC), active through August 31, 2028, on the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation registry. Main office and showroom: 2055 Trade Center Way, Naples, FL 34109. Sales branch: 6020 Radio Rd., Naples, FL 34104. Phone 239-280-6428; email contact@niancustomhomes.com. Free consultation.

## How a custom home starts

- [The lot](https://www.niancustomhomes.com/#how): one of their lots throughout Collier County, the client's own land, or a lot they help find. In association with Sun Realty, they also help clients sell a current home.
- [The plan](https://www.niancustomhomes.com/#how): designed from scratch with the client, one of their proven floor plans as it is or adjusted, or the client's own design.
- [Every selection](https://www.niancustomhomes.com/#how): "From color schemes to fixture styles", their in-house design team helps with the many selections that complete a custom home.

## Their homes

- [Six homes, with photos and captions](https://www.niancustomhomes.com/#homes): The Park Modern Home (Modern West Indies design), Villa Estate Home (large estate villa design), Oakes Estate Home (large single-family custom design), Oakes Woods Custom Home (contemporary single-family custom home), Collier Woods Custom Home (mid-size single-family custom home), Gates Custom Home (mid-size estate home).

## Also

- [Lot + Home packages](https://www.niancustomhomes.com/#packages): several finished Lot + Home packages throughout Naples and Collier County, and inventory homes for sale.
- [Remodeling](https://www.niancustomhomes.com/#packages): custom remodeling and renovation projects throughout Collier County.
- [Realtor program](https://www.niancustomhomes.com/#realtors): a 4% commission on all their new construction, 50% at closing and 50% once the certificate of occupancy is issued; they handle all customer relations throughout the construction project. Contact: sales@niancorp.com, 239-260-1523.

## The company

- [About NIAN Custom Homes](https://www.niancustomhomes.com/#about): family owned and operated, a personalized approach to building homes, two locations in Naples.
